headline_findings: The equal-work treatment variable is candidate-owned physical realization, persistence, regeneration and reuse over one invariant source-local logical workload; semantic ownership and cost ownership remain distinct.
Candidate-neutral authority/workload/oracle production is frozen once and reused; actual candidate-local access to those common inputs is counted as physical work.

Each source×candidate cell requires an isolated candidate process with an exact start after common freeze and an exact stop before court administration; prior candidate sessions or RSS history may not carry over.

CPU must be candidate-total without overwrite or nested double count, RSS must be candidate-process-local, and read/write/rewrite bytes must be observed I/O events rather than endpoint directory-size proxies.

Cold/warm fields are write-once and require explicit candidate-owned state predicates; rebuild, invalidation, stale/corrupt and interruption metrics require actual governed candidate lifecycle actions.

The preserved LiTS-A first-build receipt can receive only conditional field-by-field numeric credit after exact accounting-contract verification; the preserved LiTS-B cacheless C11 receipt receives no numeric credit because telemetry was explicitly not captured.
